evidence_against: 96 of the 120 bars sit inside a 2358.62-2609.02 trading range with complete givebacks of prior spikes (bar 1788436800000 close 2506.79 later traded to 2450.96; bar 1789128000000 high 2680.00 later traded to 2479.76), so a whole-window trading-range read remains defensible.

Both earlier bull spikes in this window fully failed, so an unresolved spike into the window high has direct precedent for reversing.
The advance from 2568.16 to 2850.00 is only ~24 bars at the very right edge of a 120-bar window whose body is a range; the trend label rests on recent bars, not on the window majority.
transition_conditions: Bull continuation: a close above 2804.59 (bar 1790020800000 high) that then accepts above 2850.00 confirms the flag breakout and keeps the bull-trend/channel read with rising Always-In relevance.

Reversal: consecutive closes below 2716.01 (bar 1790049600000 low) and then below 2700.00 put price back inside the 2568.16-2700.00 flag and shift the read toward trading-range or an mtr-like reversal of the 2358.62-2850.00 leg.

A close below 2568.16 would break the last higher swing low and mark the 2358.62-2850.00 advance as a completed leg.
A new spike bar that closes above 2850.00 without a large upper tail would restore a clearer breakout-spike phase rather than a channel phase.
